name: Ayuntamiento de Sevilla

dates.altered: Enlarged in the 19th century by Demetrio, whose neoclassical front faces the Plaza Nueva; the plateresque work faces the Plaza de San Francisco.
dates.note: The node's exemplar gives 1527-1564 to Diego de Riano. The Spanish article says only 'Se comenzó a edificar en el siglo XVI por Diego de Riaño'; the 19th-century architect's surname was truncated in the extract span and is not completed here.

survey.prepared: No revision date was printed in the extract. AN ENCYCLOPEDIA ARTICLE AND NOT A REGISTER, and an article about a council rather than about a building.

quotes.text: El edificio histórico que ocupa el Ayuntamiento constituye una de las muestras más notables de la arquitectura renacentista, con decoración menuda que popularmente se denomina plateresca.

Se comenzó a edificar en el siglo XVI por Diego de Riaño, el maestro ejecutó el sector meridional del Ayuntamiento, un pequeño edificio con solo la Sala Capitular, el apeadero, la escalera antigua y la sala de Fieles Ejecutores, además del arquillo de comunicación con el monasterio franciscano y dos plantas recubiertas de relieves platerescos con representaciones de personajes históricos y míticos, heráldicas y emblemas alusivos a los fundadores de la ciudad, como Hércules y Julio César.
Fachada plateresca del siglo XVI a la plaza de San Francisco
quotes.page: Spanish Wikipedia, infobox image caption. A CAPTION AND NOT PROSE, quoted because it is the only place either extract says WHICH front is the plateresque one.

measurements.note: Two storeys COVERED IN RELIEF, which is the one place in this cluster where a source describes plateresque ornament as clothing a whole elevation rather than as a bounded portada against a bare wall. That is the node's own claim running the other way and is reported as such.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. Its one quotation nonetheless cuts against the node's central claim and is kept for that reason.
